title: The Toll
text: A bridge of yellowed bone arches creaking over nothing. A hooded toll-keeper sits at its foot, holding out a hand with too many fingers, every one of them ringed. It does not speak, nor does it need to.

options.label: The richest House pays in gold to buy the bridge's mercy.

outcomes.text: The coins vanish into the hand, and the bridge holds.

options.label: Fight your way across; no hand with that many fingers gets your gold.

outcomes.text: The keeper calls its kin up from the nothing below.
